title: ShopAssist Account Security and Profile Management Policy - 1. Account Creation and Verification
text:
[ShopAssist Account Security and Profile Management Policy > 1. Account Creation and Verification]
- Customers can create a personal ShopAssist AI account with a valid email address and secure password.
- Passwords must contain a minimum of 8 characters, including at least one uppercase letter, one numerical digit, and one special character.
- Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) via SMS or Authenticator App is recommended and can be activated under Account Settings.

title: ShopAssist Account Security and Profile Management Policy - 2. Password Reset and Recovery
text:
[ShopAssist Account Security and Profile Management Policy > 2. Password Reset and Recovery]
- If you forget your password, click **Forgot Password** on the login portal.
- A secure, single-use password recovery link will be dispatched to your registered email address and remains valid for fifteen (15) minutes.
- If you encounter issues receiving the email, check your spam/junk folder or contact support to verify account ownership.

title: ShopAssist Account Security and Profile Management Policy - 3. Profile Information and Shipping Addresses
text:
[ShopAssist Account Security and Profile Management Policy > 3. Profile Information and Shipping Addresses]
- Customers may update email addresses, phone numbers, and default shipping/billing addresses under the **Profile Settings** page.
- Changes made to saved addresses will apply to future orders only; modifications to existing active orders must be initiated directly with customer service or the chat assistant prior to dispatch.

title: ShopAssist Account Security and Profile Management Policy - 4. Account Deletion and Privacy Rights
text:
[ShopAssist Account Security and Profile Management Policy > 4. Account Deletion and Privacy Rights]
- In accordance with GDPR and CCPA regulations, customers can request full account deletion and personal data erasure.
- Deletion requests take up to 30 days to process and are irreversible.
- To submit a formal deletion or data privacy request, contact `privacy@shopassist.ai` or ask the support assistant to open a privacy ticket.

title: ShopAssist Order Cancellation Policy - 1. Cancellation Grace Period
text:
[ShopAssist Order Cancellation Policy > 1. Cancellation Grace Period]
Customers can self-cancel an order free of charge within **60 minutes** of order placement, provided the order is still in `Pending` or `Submitted` status.

title: ShopAssist Order Cancellation Policy - 2. Cancellation Process
text:
[ShopAssist Order Cancellation Policy > 2. Cancellation Process]
1. Log into your ShopAssist account.
2. Navigate to **Order History** and locate the order you wish to cancel.
3. If eligible, click the **Cancel Order** button.
4. Alternatively, request order cancellation immediately via ShopAssist AI chat assistant or customer support by quoting the Order ID (e.g., `ORD-1001`).

title: ShopAssist Order Cancellation Policy - 3. Post-Fulfillment Window
text:
[ShopAssist Order Cancellation Policy > 3. Post-Fulfillment Window]
- Once an order transitions to `Processing`, `Packed`, or `Shipped`, automated fulfillment systems cannot halt shipment.
- In this situation, please wait for the order delivery and then initiate an easy return under our 30-day Return Policy.
- Refusing delivery at the doorstep may result in carrier return-to-sender delay and a restocking fee of 10%.

title: ShopAssist Order Cancellation Policy - 4. Cancellation Fees
text:
[ShopAssist Order Cancellation Policy > 4. Cancellation Fees]
- There are **no cancellation fees** for cancellations requested within the authorized window.
- Custom-made or personalized items cannot be cancelled once production has commenced (typically 2 hours after order submission).

title: ShopAssist Payment, Invoicing and Billing Policy - 1. Accepted Payment Methods
text:
[ShopAssist Payment, Invoicing and Billing Policy > 1. Accepted Payment Methods]
ShopAssist accepts the following secure payment options:
- **Major Credit and Debit Cards**: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, JCB, and UnionPay.
- **Digital Wallets**: Apple Pay, Google Pay, Shop Pay, PayPal, and Venmo.
- **Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL)**: Klarna and Afterpay (available on orders between $35.00 and $1,500.00, split into 4 interest-free installments).
- **ShopAssist Gift Cards**: Digital gift cards and store promotional credits.

We do not accept personal checks, money orders, cash-on-delivery (COD), or cryptocurrencies.

title: ShopAssist Payment, Invoicing and Billing Policy - 2. Invoicing and Receipts
text:
[ShopAssist Payment, Invoicing and Billing Policy > 2. Invoicing and Receipts]
- An itemized PDF invoice is automatically generated upon order completion and transmitted to your registered email address.
- Invoices detail subtotal amounts, applicable sales tax by jurisdiction, promotional discounts, shipping fees, and payment transaction IDs.
- Registered customers can download official invoices at any time under the **Orders & Billing** section of their user profile.

title: ShopAssist Payment, Invoicing and Billing Policy - 3. Payment Authorizations and Charges
text:
[ShopAssist Payment, Invoicing and Billing Policy > 3. Payment Authorizations and Charges]
- When you submit an order, your bank places a temporary authorization hold on your account for the total order amount.
- The actual capture of funds occurs only when your order has been packed and prepared for carrier pickup.
- In case of cancelled items, the pre-authorization hold drops off automatically according to your issuing bank's policies (usually within 24 to 72 hours).

[ShopAssist Payment, Invoicing and Billing Policy > 4. Failed Payments and Disputed Charges]
- Common causes of payment declines include incorrect CVV/expiration date, billing address mismatch (AVS check failed), or international transaction restrictions.

title: ShopAssist Return and Refund Policy - 1. Return Window
text:
[ShopAssist Return and Refund Policy > 1. Return Window]
Customers have thirty (30) calendar days from the date of package delivery to request a return or replacement for eligible products. Items returned after 30 days are ineligible for refunds or store credits unless covered by an extended manufacturer warranty.

title: ShopAssist Return and Refund Policy - 2. Eligibility Criteria
text:
[ShopAssist Return and Refund Policy > 2. Eligibility Criteria]
To qualify for a full refund:
- Items must be unused, unwashed, and in the exact condition received.
- Products must be in their original manufacturer packaging with all accessories, user manuals, tags, and protective seals intact.
- Proof of purchase (such as Order Confirmation ID or receipt) must accompany all return requests.

### Non-Returnable Items
- Personalized or custom-engraved merchandise.
- Perishable goods, grocery items, and gift cards.
- Intimate apparel, swimwear, and opened health/personal care items for hygiene reasons.
- Downloadable software licenses and digital media codes.

title: ShopAssist Return and Refund Policy - 3. Return Process
text:
[ShopAssist Return and Refund Policy > 3. Return Process]
1. **Initiate Return**: Visit your ShopAssist account dashboard or notify customer support via chat or email at `returns@shopassist.ai` with your Order ID and reason for return.
2. **Prepaid Shipping Label**: For damaged, defective, or incorrect items, ShopAssist generates a complimentary prepaid shipping return label. For voluntary returns (buyer remorse or incorrect sizing), a flat $5.99 return shipping deduction applies to the refund.
3. **Inspection**: Once delivered to our warehouse, our quality assurance team conducts an inspection within 2 business days.

title: ShopAssist Return and Refund Policy - 4. Refund Methods and Processing Times
text:
[ShopAssist Return and Refund Policy > 4. Refund Methods and Processing Times]
- **Original Payment Method**: Refunds are issued back to the original credit card, debit card, or PayPal account within 3 to 5 business days post-inspection.
- **Store Credit**: Customers electing store credit receive an instant ShopAssist Digital Gift Card with an extra 5% bonus balance.
- **Bank Processing**: Depending on your financial institution, funds may take an additional 2 to 7 business days to appear on your bank statement.

title: ShopAssist Return and Refund Policy - 5. Damaged or Defective Items
text:
[ShopAssist Return and Refund Policy > 5. Damaged or Defective Items]
If your merchandise arrives damaged or defective, please submit high-resolution photos and report the problem within 48 hours of delivery. A replacement will be expedited at zero cost, or an immediate full refund will be processed.

title: ShopAssist Shipping and Delivery Policy - 1. Shipping Methods and Delivery Timelines
text:
[ShopAssist Shipping and Delivery Policy > 1. Shipping Methods and Delivery Timelines]
ShopAssist AI offers multiple shipping tiers across domestic and international destinations:

| Shipping Tier | Estimated Transit Time | Cost | Free Shipping Threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Ground | 3 - 5 Business Days | $4.99 | Free on orders over $50.00 |
| Expedited Two-Day | 2 Business Days | $9.99 | Free on orders over $150.00 |
| Priority Overnight | 1 Business Day (Next Day) | $19.99 | Not eligible for threshold |
| International Standard | 7 - 14 Business Days | $24.99 | Varies by country duties |

title: ShopAssist Shipping and Delivery Policy - 2. Order Processing & Fulfillment
text:
[ShopAssist Shipping and Delivery Policy > 2. Order Processing & Fulfillment]
- Orders placed before 2:00 PM EST Monday through Friday are processed and dispatched on the same business day.
- Orders placed after 2:00 PM EST or during weekends and observed federal holidays will be dispatched on the subsequent business day.
- Once dispatched, an automated shipping confirmation email with carrier tracking numbers (FedEx, UPS, USPS, DHL) is generated.

title: ShopAssist Shipping and Delivery Policy - 3. Shipping Address Modifications
text:
[ShopAssist Shipping and Delivery Policy > 3. Shipping Address Modifications]
- Address modifications can be processed within thirty (30) minutes of order placement while the order status remains `Pending` or `Processing`.
- Once an order transitions to `Shipped` or `Out for Delivery`, carrier rerouting fees of $12.00 may apply, subject to carrier discretion.

title: ShopAssist Shipping and Delivery Policy - 4. Lost, Stolen, or Delayed Packages
text:
[ShopAssist Shipping and Delivery Policy > 4. Lost, Stolen, or Delayed Packages]
- **Delayed Shipments**: In the event of severe weather or carrier delays exceeding 3 business days past the projected delivery window, customers qualify for a shipping fee reimbursement.
- **Lost in Transit**: If tracking shows no activity for five (5) consecutive business days, contact our support team. We will immediately initiate a carrier trace and dispatch a complimentary replacement.
- **Stolen Packages / Porch Piracy**: If an order is marked `Delivered` but cannot be located, please verify around entryways and with neighbors. If unlocated after 24 hours, contact customer support to submit a signature-verification dispute ticket.
